The aircraft landed safely with no fatalities or major injuries to passengers and crew.  An NTSB investigation found that the incident was caused by a failure in the fuselage skin due to metal fatigue.

The plane crashed into the sea wall while attempting the emergency landing. On 10 July 2002, the flight was unable to land at Fuhlsbüttel Airport due to weather.  Attempts were made to divert to other airports at Berlin and Eberswalde before the crew decided to land at Werneuchen.  On landing, the aircraft struck an earth bank which ripped off all three undercarriage legs, and came to rest on its belly with an engine on fire.  One of the sixteen passengers suffered minor injuries.  The aircraft was written off.

The Boeing 737 suffered a collapse of its front landing gear while landing at LaGuardia Airport, injuring 9 people on board.  The aircraft, which was worth an estimated $15.5 million at the time, was written off as a total loss and scrapped as a result of the accident.
Eastern Airlines Flight 935 | Eastern Airlines Flight 935 was a scheduled commercial passenger flight operated by Eastern Airlines.  On September 22, 1981, Eastern Airlines Flight 935, a Lockheed L-1011 TriStar jet suffered an uncontained engine failure which led to a loss of 3 out of the 4 hydraulic systems aboard the aircraft at an altitude of 10000 ft MSL.  The crew were able to land the aircraft safely to an emergency landing at John F. Kennedy International Airport with some limited use of the outboard spoilers, the inboard ailerons and the horizontal stabilizer, plus differential engine power of the remaining two engines. Deadlock prevention algorithms | In computer science, deadlock prevention algorithms are used in concurrent programming when multiple processes must acquire more than one shared resource.  If two or more concurrent processes obtain multiple resources indiscriminately, a situation can occur where each process has a resource needed by another process.  As a result, none of the processes can obtain all the resources it needs, so all processes are blocked from further execution.  This situation is called a deadlock.  A deadlock prevention algorithm organizes resource usage by each process to ensure that at least one process is always able to get all the resources it needs.
